Managed Elasticsearch hosting is a provisioned, patched, backed-up Elasticsearch instance you run beside your app for search and analytics.

It's brilliant at full-text search with relevance ranking, faceted product filters, autocomplete, and log data. It is not your primary database. Keep the source of truth in PostgreSQL or MySQL and index a copy into Elasticsearch for the things a search engine does well.

Managed Elasticsearch Hosting: Search Your Database Can't Do Alone

Quick thread 🧵
Managed Elasticsearch hosting is a provisioned, patched, backed-up Elasticsearch instance you run beside your app for search and analytics.
It's brilliant at full-text search with relevance ranking, faceted product filters, autocomplete, and log data.
It is not your primary database.
Keep the source of truth in PostgreSQL or MySQL and index a copy into Elasticsearch for the things a search engine does well.
